title: Gold Game
description: A manually-reviewed full game sequence for Validation Gate 3. Lives in rules_tests/gold_games/<id>.json. Per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md, this is always a SYNTHETIC_* run regardless of whether deck_versions references real frozen decks for flavor/context - it may never contribute to deck-performance statistics.

run_class.description: Always one of these two - see docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md. A gold game is by definition a laboratory fixture, never a deck-backed run, even when it references real deck versions for commander-specific behavior testing.

representative_of_deck_draws.description: Always false - present explicitly per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md so a reader never has to infer it.

synthetic_mana.description: Whether mana sources in this fixture are arbitrary stand-ins rather than a real deck's actual mana base.

artificial_state_elements.description: Free-text list of exactly which parts of the state are intentionally not deck-representative.

interaction_under_test.description: The specific rule/interaction/sequence being validated - an INT-#### id where applicable, or a Comprehensive Rules citation.

material_characteristics.description: What about this game DOES matter to the result and must be faithful.

abstracted_characteristics.description: What's deliberately simplified because it doesn't affect the question under test.

expected_winner.description: Seat number, or null for a draw/undetermined test.

win_recognition_check.description: What specifically confirms the win was recognized correctly (e.g. state-based action, specific card's win condition text).
